subject.title: [Feishu] Interactive Card message content parsing missing

question: What agent-visible payload contract should Feishu interactive cards use across direct inbound cards, card-action form/select callbacks, and merge_forward card sub-messages?
rationale: The direct inbound gap is source-proven, but exposing full card/form/select data while preserving command-style button behavior is a channel behavior contract choice.

options.title: Coordinate scoped Feishu plugin fixes
options.body: Keep this issue as the broad tracker, land direct inbound parser reuse in the Feishu plugin, and let the callback-field and merge_forward issues own their narrower payload details.

options.title: Reduce to direct inbound only
options.body: Retitle or split this work so it covers only direct interactive message parsing and leaves action callbacks and merge_forward entirely to their existing linked items.

options.title: Defer full payload exposure
options.body: Pause the broad direction until maintainers decide agents should not receive full Feishu card/form payloads beyond existing text extraction.

recommendation.title: Coordinate scoped Feishu plugin fixes
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the broad tracker, land direct inbound parser reuse in the Feishu plugin, and let the callback-field and merge_forward issues own their narrower payload details.

likelyOwner.reason: The affected behavior is Feishu plugin-owned, and the package metadata names this handle as the community-maintained plugin contact.
